name: Namo Laxmi Yojana
benefit:
> ***Total Financial Assistance:*** - Each eligible girl will receive a total financial support of ₹50,000/- on completion of classes 9th to 12th in government, aided, and private schools.
> **Class 9th-10th Benefit:** - ₹10,000/- per annum (₹500/- per month based on attendance × 10) and the remaining 50% will be credited via DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) after passing the Class 10th boar
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a girl. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 9th to 12th in any Government, Government-aided, or private secondary/higher secondary school in Gujarat. 1. The applicant must have an annual family income of less than or equal to ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The applicant must maintain regular attendance to be eligible for monthly assistance.
